## MOBILE-UI-FINAL-R4-20261023: **PASS** — no P1 or P2

**SOURCE_ONLY · TESTS_NOT_RUN.** I read only `reports/mobile-ui-final-r4-20261023/`. No shell, tests, Unity, MCP or other AI, and I edited nothing. I couldn't recompute the hashes; the manifest lists:

| File | SHA-256 (abbreviated) |
|---|---|
| GrowthClient | `635afdc0…948545ac` |
| ExpeditionClient | `c17ab21a…29e62308` |
| MobileViewport tests | `b6903ba7…f9e0a46e` |
| MobileLegacySurface tests | `9dfde563…29b40d39` |

The 63/63 matrix, the 763-test full suite, Edit Mode and the fresh native build are yours. This review doesn't approve them, or any native, CI or device result.

Paths are under `reports/mobile-ui-final-r4-20261023/after/client/MemoryForgeUnity/Assets/`.

**Growth: the oversized super-move tile on the short 1560×720 screen is fixed** (`Scripts/MemoryForgeGrowthClient.cs:216-234`)
- **New heading:** "필살기" is a single heading above the strip, laid out like the HP and stats lines. It is 14 sp, sits in the same scroll content, and is followed by a 12-unit gap.
- **Per-button caption:** each button now shows the name on line 1 and gauge/max on line 2. Nothing is lost: the action word moved to the heading, and a full gauge still reads as "100/100" without relying on colour.
- **Spacing:** line spacing is 0.85, and `WholeText` re-measures the caption before its height is captured. Re-measuring falls back to the original box height (`ultimateHeight − 24`), not the first measurement, so the tighter spacing really does shrink the caption.
- **Unchanged:** font, 312 width, and the 24 left / 16 top margins.
- **Row height:** caption height + 24 (16 top, 8 bottom). It still feeds the strip, its clipping viewport, every button and the party scroll, and the R3 parent-stretched frame borders are kept.
- **Check against the stress case:** your measured 218 with the old padding implies the second line sits at 0.85 of the line height. With the new padding that makes the tile about 210 against the 214 party viewport, so the whole button can be scrolled into view.
- **Test:** the new full-gauge check that exactly one "필살기" text exists is valid, because no button caption contains it any more.

**Expedition: R3's exhaust LOWs are fixed** (`Scripts/MemoryForgeExpeditionClient.cs:1563`)
- **Contrast:** "소멸N" now gets the same `Strong` shadow as the other pile counts. Colour, font and value are unchanged, and the shadow doesn't affect layout.
- **Width:** the phone label is now 136 wide (0 to HandLeft), so it ends exactly where the hand viewport starts.
- **Unchanged:** the y position (HandTop+112), the AP-number lift and the desktop placement. Desktop now just adds the shadow.
- **Tests:**
  - The projection adds draw 99 / exhaust 88 on both phones at 130%, with the existing one-line, own-label, safe-area and glyph-separation checks.
  - The detached AP gem plus pile row, Core hash and no-POST checks are kept.
  - The hand-versus-pile-controls selector at `Tests/PlayMode/MobileLegacySurfacePlayModeTests.cs:137` now matches `ExhaustCount` or the "소멸" prefix. No assertion was removed.

**Optional, non-blocking:** the 16-unit top-margin assertion measures the caption's box, not its glyphs, and line spacing below 1 is the case where uGUI text can creep upward. With this font's tall built-in top space, my estimate keeps the first-line glyphs 16 or more units below the button top even in that worst case. A glyph-level check would settle it.

Still tracked and outside this delta: the pick-grid LOW and the wording LOW.
